data.name: Shores of Vaelithar
data.detailed_description:
Cast forsaken upon the Shores of Vaelithar, you are but a hapless villager thrust into this dark, unforgiving world to bear the spark of fate.

Ride across epic landscapes to fight terrible foes, conquer the storm-swept mountain and the great dragon that guards its peaks, unearth sacred relics to forge legendary weapons and join with friends or compete with rival heroes in an expansive procedural endgame dungeon experience.

In order to survive in these cursed lands you must learn the ways of the ancient demi-god hunting artificers, unearth their Living Tomes, wield their power, and with it claim the eternal majesty of the dark gods for yourself, or endeavor to seal it forever in this action-packed, first-person dark fantasy RPG adventure.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

From the whispering pages of ancient tomes, learn the ways of the warrior, wizard, or rogue and with it conquer the terrors lurking in the shadows of this cursed land.

FORGE YOUR DESTINY

Do you desire the eternal power of the dark gods or endeavor to seal it away once and for all?

BECOME THE LEGEND

Through fire and fury, forge legendary weapons and master your skills. Fight through the depths of the veil against the armies of darkness and rise a legend.

About the Devs

OMW Game Studio is a small indie fellowship forged in the passion of turning dreams into reality. From viral concept to playable reality, the team is focused and driven to deliver a hand crafted quality retro dark fantasy experience.
Join our discord, mailing list or follow along on socials for consistent progress updates.

data.short_description: The retro dark fantasy RPG adventure you've always wanted. Learn the veil-borne arts, hunt demi-gods with blade and magic, and rise a legend in this classic sword and sorcery come to life. Choose your path, Forge your Destiny, Become the Legend.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (latest service pack)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-8320 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 2GB or AMD Radeon HD 7870 2GB (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (latest service pack)
  • Processor: equivalent) Intel Core i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 590 (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains a level of violence and blood standard with medieval combat games. The story contains details relating to blood sacrifice to gods. There is likely to be revealing garments on women but no explicit nudity.
